title: Knowledge-Guided Floodwater Level Reasoning for Cloud-Edge Collaborative Monitoring
abstract: arXiv:2611.01970v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Frequent urban floodwater poses a serious threat to the safety and efficiency of intelligent transportation systems. Existing vision-based methods for floodwater level detection face two main limitations. First, the lack of explicit reasoning leads to poor detection performance and little interpretability. Second, these methods struggle to generalize to the complex and varied real-world road scenes seen from different viewpoints. To address this, we reformulate the task as an explicit visual reasoning problem and propose HydroReasoner, a floodwater level reasoning framework designed for cloud-edge collaboration. HydroReasoner builds on Qwen2.5-VL and is trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization. To address the scarcity of reasoning process annotations, we build a floodwater domain knowledge graph HydroKG and design a novel KG path reward. Through deterministic graph traversal over HydroKG, this reward supervises the model

translated_title: 知识引导的积水水位推理：面向云边协同监测
translated_abstract: 频繁发生的城市积水对智能交通系统的安全和运行效率构成了严重威胁。现有的基于视觉的积水水位检测方法存在两个主要局限：首先，缺乏显式推理导致检测性能较差且几乎没有可解释性；其次，这些方法难以泛化到从不同视角观察到的复杂多变的真实道路场景中。为解决这些问题，我们将该任务重新表述为一个显式视觉推理问题，并提出了HydroReasoner——一个为云边协同设计的积水水位推理框架。HydroReasoner基于Qwen2.5-VL构建，并采用组相对策略优化进行训练。为解决推理过程标注稀缺的问题，我们构建了积水领域知识图谱HydroKG，并设计了一种新颖的知识图谱路径奖励。通过对HydroKG进行确定性的图遍历，该奖励对模型进行监督……
tldr: 提出基于Qwen2.5-VL的积水水位显式视觉推理框架HydroReasoner，通过构建积水领域知识图谱HydroKG并设计知识图谱路径奖励，结合组相对策略优化训练，实现了可解释且泛化性强的云边协同积水监测。
en_tdlr: Proposes HydroReasoner, a Qwen2.5-VL-based explicit visual reasoning framework for floodwater level detection, which introduces a floodwater domain knowledge graph (HydroKG) with a novel KG path reward and GRPO training to achieve interpretable, generalizable cloud-edge collaborative monitoring.
